This unit operates a pair of detainer drones. These do not deal a lot of damage but are effective at distracting enemy attacks, thus offering indirect protection to more valuable units and assets.

Note that the larger Arachnid types such as Scorpions, Plasma Grenadiers and Tankers are known to ignore the detainer drones and will focus their attacks on the police officers or other targets in their range.
This unit is not equipped with combat in mind but can construct defensive turrets and repair mechanical units.

Effective against small amounts of light to medium armored targets. The cannons overheat quickly, making this turret ineffective against large numbers of enemies.
The autocannons can also engage air targets.

Effective against concentrated groups of lightly armored targets. Ineffective against medium to heavily armored targets.
The high projectile arc of the mortars allow firing over any obstacles but incapable of firing at targets that are too close to the turret.

High velocity gun designed to take on heavily armored targets. Its slow reload makes the turret ineffective against large numbers of enemies. 
Its tall understructure allows the weapon to fire over obstacles and elevations that are one level higher than the turret.

Very long range missile launcher, effective at countering long range enemies. Its slow reload and large minimum range make it unsuited to engage large numbers of enemies.
The missiles can be fired over any obstacles or elevations but cannot engage aerial targets.

The Riot Shield Squad is a heavily armored police unit designed to resist enemy attacks. Their grenade launchers can whittle down even the biggest enemy units but lack the rate of fire to effectively deal with large numbers of enemies.

The Peacekeeper command vehicle is a lightly armored support unit that can call in reinforcements, boost the damage output of friendly units and provide indirect fire support with its dual grenade launchers.

In small numbers these flying Arachnids lack significant destructive firepower. They are often encountered near their nests, however, which incessantly churn out a relentless swarm of Hornets. Swift action to eliminate these nest is thus an absolute necessity.

The Hornet Tanker is not a distinct Arachnid subspecies but essentially a symbiotic pairing of a Tanker and a Hornet nest. These dorsal nests unleash an endless stream of Hornets that can overwhelm infantry and lightly armored vehicles. Despite their vulnerability to concentrated rifle fire and attacks from the M7 Cyclone, the Hornet Tanker’s ability to keep spawning additional Hornets from afar makes it a persistent threat. Reaching and neutralizing this monstrosity, while managing the Hornet swarms, requires a careful and strategic approach.

This Arachnid is a formidable foe capable of launching explosive projectiles that inflict significant area damage to unarmored targets. Armored units should exercise extreme caution as well: When the Ravager loses its tail from battle damage, it will charge in with its massive pincers that can easily penetrate armor.

Due to its unique capacity to absorb hits, the calibre of the weapons to use against it is not the main importance, but the volume of fire is. These monstrocities should be countered with a combination of hard-hitters and high rate-of-fire units.

Bursters eject a volatile substance that combusts after a short time delay. The resulting blast is devastating against infantry and armor alike.
The dorsal sack of glands that produce this substance also tends to explode upon the creature’s death, causing an even more destructive shockwave.

The M7 weapon platform provides highly mobile fire support. The Cyclone's autocannons can deal with medium armored ground and air targets, and it can use its jump ability to reach advantageous positions or extract itself from trouble.
This mobile mechanized missile launcher excels at providing long range fire support. It is capable of providing a relentless missile bombardment to cripple even the toughest targets.

It can operate in mobile or deployed mode:
Mobile Mode: 
• Fire missiles in bursts
• Can fire in any direction while standing still
• Can fire over any units and elevations

Deployed Mode: 
• Fire missiles individually with increased range and rate of fire
• Must rotate the missile pods to engage targets in different directions
• Can fire only over 1 elevation level

The A-12 Pegasus gunship is equipped with an array of weapon systems to deal with various ground targets. Its minigun provides reliable fire support while the rocket pods provide an extra punch against more resilient targets.
The gunship can also engage air targets with its minigun, but it does not excel at this role.

The "Jumpjet Assault Cannon" Troopers provides a flexible means to engage medium armored targets. While the recoilless rifle cannot be fired through friendly units, the jumpjet suit allows the operator to quickly redeploy to advantageous positions.

Units can be set to prioritize firing at specific enemy types instead of aiming for the nearest target.

For example: To make your Snipers target Spitter Bugs even if there are other enemy types in their firing range, the target priority setting allows you to do so without having to micromanage their targets manually.
